checks.text: The page heading is "Purchase Order" and, with no orders, the list area shows the text "No purchase orders yet".

Clicking the button "New order" opens a form. Filling the field labelled "Vendor" with "Acme Corp", the field labelled "Order date" with "2024-01-15", and clicking the button "Save" adds a row to the table with "Acme Corp" and "2024-01-15".

In the new order form, clicking the button "Add line item" adds a row. Filling the field labelled "Description" with "Widget", the field labelled "Quantity" with "10", the field labelled "Unit price" with "25.00", the field labelled "Discount %" with "5", and the field labelled "Tax %" with "8", then clicking "Save" shows a table row with "Acme Corp", "Widget", "10", "$25.00", and a total of "$256.50".
After saving the order from A3, the table shows a row with "Acme Corp" and a total of "$256.50". Clicking the button "Delete Acme Corp" removes that row and the list shows "No purchase orders yet".

With the order from A3 saved, clicking the button "Export CSV" copies a CSV string to the clipboard that contains the header "vendor,order_date,description,quantity,unit_price,discount_pct,tax_pct,total" and a data row "Acme Corp,2024-01-15,Widget,10,25.00,5,8,256.50".
In the new order form, adding a line item with Description "Gadget", Quantity "2", Unit price "100.00", Discount % "0", Tax % "10", then clicking "Save" shows a total of "$220.00" for that line item.

The table has a column header "Total". Clicking the header "Total" sorts the rows in descending order by total. With two orders (Acme Corp total $256.50 and Beta Inc total $500.00), the first row shows "Beta Inc" and the second shows "Acme Corp".
Typing "Acme" in the search box labelled "Search" filters the table to show only the row with "Acme Corp". Clearing the search shows all rows again.
Reload keeps the order with vendor "Acme Corp" and total "$256.50" visible in the table.
